import { Box, TextField } from "@mui/material";

export default function Login() {
    return (
        <Box
            display="flex"
            justifyContent="center"
            alignItems="center"
            height="100vh"
            width="100%"
        >
            <Box
                width="30%"
                bgcolor="whitesmoke"
            >
                <TextField id="outlined-basic" label="Outlined" variant="outlined" />
            </Box>
        </Box>
    )
}
